name: camera-ready
description: Camera-ready sources: every manifest arm (73 arm ids: the 60 of 20ad7d5, the three GP radius arms of the 2026-10-12 amendment, and the nine control-block arms of tag cr-controls-2026-10-12, which read ${CRCTL}/<arm id>/ = results/guacamol/cr2026ctl of the control clone and must carry that tag's commit; the six '<arm>__s82' replication arms hold base-solver files on seeds 82-121 and are grouped by provenance.cr_arm, never pooled with '<arm>') reads ONLY its directory ${CR}/<arm id>/ (results/guacamol/cr2026 of the production clone, written by scripts/cr/run_cell.py through cr_queue.py at the tagged commit); file names are run_cell.cell_filename (ours_<solver>_<poli task>_s<seed>_128d.json, _sd8/_sd64 for the GeoCMA D~ arms); provenance required: git_commit = the --expected-commit of the arm's root, git_dirty False, provenance.cr_arm = the arm id and provenance.run_overrides = the manifest's. Queue sidecars (crash/interrupted/running/collision/tmp, attempts/) are recognised by the loader. GaBO and Riemannian Matern GP run on kajman's CPU and are read from ${CRCPU} (a copy of kajman's production files; override with --root CRCPU=...). Wave 4 (papenmeier_msr_published_norm_box) is optional. Non-rerunnable arms (RUN_RULES 3) read their stored directories with anchored file names. The posted (rebuttal-era) generation is loaded from sources_legacy.json under the namespace 'posted:' for the correspondence tables only; that include is optional (an absent old arm is reported and its correspondence rows show n/a, a missing cell inside a present old arm still fails). GEN v5: the published-recipe arms of wave p (RUN_RULES 2026-10-12, 2026-10-13 revision 1 (f), 2026-10-19) read ${CRPUB}/<arm id>/ = results/guacamol/cr2026pub of the published-recipe clone and must carry the commit of tag cr-verify-2026-10-13 (--expected-commit CRPUB=963ef04...). Only the printed variants are listed: the frozen-noise Papenmeier arms (papenmeier_msr_reference, papenmeier_mle_scaled_reference) are not printed, because the learned-noise variants passed the verification, and are never read. In camera-ready mode the arms of crlib/scope.py NOT_LOADED_ARMS are removed before loading (RUN_RULES 2026-10-14) and the posted include is not loaded. Rerun of 2026-11-02: the arms cmaes_full_rd, cmaes_full_rd_pop5 and baxus_cr read ${CRRD}/<arm id>/ = results/guacamol/cr2026rd of the clone at commit 1ea2f7d (--expected-commit CRRD=1ea2f7d8...); their surrogate_fallback_count also counts invalid molecules, so their fallback steps are counted from the per-step fallback fields of published_recipe (fallback_rule recipe_step_fallback, crlib/loader.py). Control C4 (tag cr-controls-lbfgs-2026-10-14 = 2a899ad, wave c3) is the arm hvarfner_scaled_gp_sphere_lbfgs; its files are in the control block's directory and carry that tag's commit, so it reads root ${CRC4} (the same directory as ${CRCTL}) with its own expected commit (--expected-commit CRC4=...). Since 2026-11-06 it is the shell x continuous cell of the printed factorial (RUN_RULES 2026-11-06 16:30).
